## API of library/db.py (a dependency you import — use it from here, do NOT `cat` it):
```
import sqlite3
from typing import List, Optional


def get_connection(db_path: str) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open a SQLite connection at db_path with Row factory and return it."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


def init_schema(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """Create the books, members, and loans tables if they do not exist."""
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS books (title TEXT PRIMARY KEY, author TEXT, copies INTEGER)"
    )
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS members (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY)"
    )
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loans (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            book_title TEXT REFERENCES books(title),
            member_name TEXT REFERENCES members(name),
            checkout_date TEXT,
            due_date TEXT,
            returned_date TEXT DEFAULT NULL
        )"
    )
    conn.commit()


def book_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if a book with the given title exists in the database."""
    row = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM books WHERE title=? LIMIT 1", (title,)).fetchone()
    return row is not None


def member_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if a member with the given name exists in the database."""
    row = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM members WHERE name=? LIMIT 1", (name,)).fetchone()
    return row is not None


def available_copies(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> int:
    """Return total copies minus active (unreturned) loans for the book; 0 if missing."""
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT b.copies - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.returned_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS avail
         FROM books b LEFT JOIN loans l ON b.title = l.book_title
         WHERE b.title=? GROUP BY b.id",
        (title,),
    ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return 0
    return max(row["avail"], 0)


def add_book(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, author: str, copies: int) -> None:
    """Insert a new book record or ignore if it already exists."""
    conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO books (title, author, copies) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                 (title, author, copies))
    conn.commit()


def add_member(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> None:
    """Insert a new member record or ignore if it already exists."""
    conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO members (name) VALUES (?)", (name,))
    conn.commit()


def checkout_book(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    book_title: str,
    member_name: str,
    checkout_date: str,
    due_date: str,
) -> None:
    """Insert an active loan record for the given book and member."""
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO loans (book_title, member_name, checkout_date, due_date)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (book_title, member_name, checkout_date, due_date),
    )
    conn.commit()


def return_book(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    book_title: str,
    member_name: str,
    return_date: str,
) -> bool:
    """Mark a matching active loan as returned; return True if a row was updated."""
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE loans SET returned_date=?
         WHERE book_title=? AND member_name=? AND returned_date IS NULL",
        (return_date, book_title, member_name),
    )
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.rowcount > 0


def active_loan_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection, book_title: str, member_name: str) -> bool
```
